occasions.decided_by: craving, what is in the fridge, 10-minute delivery
occasions.channel: Blinkit / Zepto / Instamart, the kitchen cupboard

occasions.moment: straight after the gym, 45 minutes before a proper meal
occasions.competes_with: a whey shake, eggs, a banana, dal-chawal at home, nothing
occasions.decided_by: protein per serving, habit, what the trainer said
occasions.channel: gym counter, HealthKart, Amazon, the gym bag

occasions.moment: leaving the house late, will not sit down to eat

occasions.decided_by: one hand, no crumbs, keeps until 11am

occasions.moment: a weekend or a bad day — wants a treat but not to feel bad about it

occasions.decided_by: permission — whether it reads as a treat or as a compromise

occasions.moment: airport, long drive, or a two-hour commute with no real meal in sight
occasions.competes_with: airport sandwich, chips, nuts, a Snickers at the counter, nothing
occasions.decided_by: portability, shelf life, what the counter is selling
occasions.channel: airport store, highway stop, petrol pump, packed from home

occasions.moment: a standing daily habit someone has decided to keep
occasions.competes_with: a powder, gummies, a multivitamin, real food, nothing
occasions.decided_by: routine, whether it is working, cost per day
occasions.channel: Amazon subscribe, HealthKart, the pharmacy, D2C

occasions.moment: the monthly or weekly shop — buying for other people as well as themselves

a banana or an apple from the fruit cart — ₹10-₹20
leftover mithai in the fridge after any festival
nothing at all — waiting it out until the next meal

dispositions.label: switcher_afternoon_bar_trial
dispositions.anchor:
Sits at a counter through the afternoon and the tea-and-biscuit habit was blamed for a widening waist by a nurse at a camp.

Tries a different afternoon thing every few months — roasted chana, then a bar a colleague's daughter ordered, now back to a banana. Around ₹20-40 a day, tops.

Knows the bar filled her up longer than biscuits. Does NOT know which brand it was — the wrapper went in the bin. Does NOT know these things are also sold as tubs and powders.

Wants the four o'clock hunger to stop without a heavy stomach. Rejects paying near ₹100 for one small bar when fruit is at the gate.

Ate a Yogabar a younger colleague brought from Nagpur for three afternoons, then went back to buying a banana from the cart outside.

dispositions.label: switcher_night_sweet_swap
dispositions.anchor:
The house is quiet by ten and something sweet after the last serial has become the one thing that is hers. A daughter-in-law keeps suggesting substitutes.

Cycles what she keeps in the fridge for that hour — mithai, then dates, then a bar the daughter-in-law ordered on Blinkit. Never spends past ₹100 on it.

Knows the date-sweetened bar tasted like a laddoo pressed flat. Does NOT know what collagen or whey are for. Does NOT know which of these are made abroad or here.

Wants the sweet want to end, not to be lectured. Rejects anything that tastes like medicine or leaves her hunting the fridge again at midnight.

Kept a Whole Truth bar in the fridge for the eleven o'clock sweet for a fortnight, then went back to the leftover Diwali mithai.
